findings.claim: Jabil 10-Q（FY2026 Q2，期末 2026-02-28）：最高法院推翻 IEEPA 關稅（含部分中國商品）；公司持續監控潛在退稅並評估影響，尚未認列任何退稅。
findings.source: SEC Form 10-Q, Jabil Inc, quarter ended 2026-02-28
findings.excerpt: The Supreme Court issued a ruling striking down tariffs imposed under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act Jabil continues to monitor the situation, including any potential refunds of such tariffs, and evaluate the impact on its results. No potential refunds have been recorded.

findings.claim: Jabil 10-Q（期末 2026-05-31）：已開始收到先前繳納的 IEEPA 關稅退款，對經營結果無重大影響；全球關稅格局仍快速變動。
findings.source: SEC Form 10-Q, Jabil Inc, quarter ended 2026-05-31

findings.claim: Jabil FY2025 10-K 風險因素：與中國的貿易爭端或政治分歧已經且可能造成關稅等措施，對公司業務產生不利影響。
findings.source: SEC Form 10-K, Jabil Inc, FY ended 2025-08-31

note: 未找到 Jabil 專屬 Section 232 揭露，也未查到 Jabil 被列入美國實體清單；2026-02 一則低品質聚合站稱 Jabil 面臨新 15% 全球關稅，未能核實，不採。
